item.title: The Union are offering free tickets to fans attending their first soccer game
item.description: The idea was conceived by John Parker, a veteran of the local soccer scene. His many stops in the sport include seven years working for Union part-owner Richie Graham at investment firm Striker Partners and media and marketing company For Soccer. Read more at Inquirer.com
